definition.description: Presence of contrast enhancement in the leptomeninges on brain imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if contrast-enhanced brain MRI reports indicate the presence or absence of abnormal leptomeningeal enhancement.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no brain MRI with contrast is available or if the report does not mention the leptomeninges.
definition.name: leptomeningeal_enhancement_presence

definition.description: Whether lesions are present in the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if the pretreatment patient record (including physical examinations, imaging reports, or diagnostic notes) indicates the presence of lesions.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the record does not mention lesions or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence or absence.
definition.name: lesion_presence

definition.description: The maximum linear dimension of the lesion.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the lesion's largest dimension in centimeters. If a range is provided, extract the upper limit.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing or ambiguous documentation as null.
definition.name: lesion_size

definition.description: The sequential order of the therapy regimen currently being administered or the most recent regimen attempted for the target condition.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the line of therapy designated in the pretreatment record (e.g., 'first line', 'second line', 'third-line').
definition.missing_value_rule: If the line of therapy is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: line_of_therapy

definition.description: Whether the patient is receiving lipid-lowering therapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence of lipid-lowering medications (e.g., statins, fibrates, bile acid sequestrants, PCSK9 inhibitors) from the pretreatment medication list or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of lipid-lowering medication use or a specific denial of such therapy.
definition.name: lipid_lowering_therapy_use

definition.description: The daily dose of lisinopril administered to the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of the lisinopril dose in milligrams (mg) from the patient's medication list or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if lisinopril is not mentioned or the dose is not specified.
definition.name: lisinopril_dose

definition.description: The overall qualitative clinical status of liver function.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported status of liver function from the clinical record; documentation such as 'wnl' (within normal limits) or 'normal' should be mapped to 'Normal', while mentions of liver dysfunction, impairment, or abnormal liver tests should be mapped to 'Abnormal'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no assessment of liver function is documented.
definition.name: liver_function

definition.description: Presence of metastatic disease in the liver.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether imaging reports (such as CT, MRI, or PET/CT) or pathology reports identify metastatic lesions in the liver or explicitly state the absence of liver metastases.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the liver is not mentioned or the presence/absence of metastasis is not documented in the record.
definition.name: liver_metastasis_presence

definition.description: The patient's residential living arrangement and household composition.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the patient's residential arrangement from the social history or relevant notes, categorizing whether the patient lives alone, with a spouse/partner, with a child, or in another arrangement (e.g., other relatives or institutional care).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the living situation is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: living_situation

definition.description: The specific lobe of the lung that was surgically removed during a lobectomy procedure.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the lung lobe specified as being removed in the surgical history, radiology reports, or pathology reports (e.g., 'right lower lobectomy' maps to 'Right Lower Lobe').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no lobectomy is documented or if the specific lobe removed is not identified.
definition.name: lobectomy_type

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
